pages.text: The guide book is the c0de player guide as an in-game book.$(br2)It needs the mod Patchouli. You get the book once, the first time you join a world with c0de. Without Patchouli, there is no book and no recipe.
A book and a PROGRAM block, in any shape.
You forgot which item crafts a FLOAT type block. Open the guide book and look it up in the chapter on tools, without leaving the game.
